# Numeric limits cap downstack history in navigation comments.
as 'Test <test@example.com>'
at '2026-10-25T18:00:00Z'

mkdir repo
cd repo
git init
git commit --allow-empty -m 'Initial commit'
shamhub-setup
shamhub register alice
shamhub new origin alice/example.git
env SHAMHUB_USERNAME=alice
gs auth login
git push origin main

git add feat1.txt
gs branch create -m 'Add feature 1' feat1
gs bs --fill

git add feat2.txt
gs branch create -m 'Add feature 2' feat2
gs bs --fill

git add feat3.txt
gs branch create -m 'Add feature 3' feat3
gs bs --fill

git add feat4.txt
gs branch create -m 'Add feature 4' feat4
gs bs --fill

git add feat5.txt
gs branch create -m 'Add feature 5' feat5
gs bs --fill

# Record three merged CRs below the two remaining open CRs.
shamhub merge alice/example 1
shamhub merge alice/example 2
shamhub merge alice/example 3
gs repo sync
gs branch restack

git config spice.submit.navigationComment.downstack 1
gs bs
shamhub dump comments 5
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/one.txt

git config spice.submit.navigationComment.downstack 2
gs bs
shamhub dump comments 5
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/two.txt

git config spice.submit.navigationComment.downstack open
gs bs
shamhub dump comments 5
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/open.txt

# Limiting display must not discard stored history.
git config spice.submit.navigationComment.downstack all
gs bs
shamhub dump comments 5
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/all.txt

# Invalid configuration is rejected before submission.
git config spice.submit.navigationComment.downstack -1
! gs bs
stderr 'expected all, open, or a positive integer'
git config spice.submit.navigationComment.downstack 0
! gs bs
stderr 'expected all, open, or a positive integer'
-- repo/feat1.txt --
feature 1
-- repo/feat2.txt --
feature 2
-- repo/feat3.txt --
feature 3
-- repo/feat4.txt --
feature 4
-- repo/feat5.txt --
feature 5
-- golden/one.txt --
- change: 5
  body: |
    This change is part of the following stack:

    - #4
        - #5 ◀

    <sub>Change managed by [git-spice](https://abhinav.github.io/git-spice/).</sub>
    <!-- gs:navigation comment -->
-- golden/two.txt --
- change: 5
  body: |
    This change is part of the following stack:

    - #3
        - #4
            - #5 ◀

    <sub>Change managed by [git-spice](https://abhinav.github.io/git-spice/).</sub>
    <!-- gs:navigation comment -->
-- golden/open.txt --
- change: 5
  body: |
    This change is part of the following stack:

    - #4
        - #5 ◀

    <sub>Change managed by [git-spice](https://abhinav.github.io/git-spice/).</sub>
    <!-- gs:navigation comment -->
-- golden/all.txt --
- change: 5
  body: |
    This change is part of the following stack:

    - #1
        - #2
            - #3
                - #4
                    - #5 ◀

    <sub>Change managed by [git-spice](https://abhinav.github.io/git-spice/).</sub>
    <!-- gs:navigation comment -->
